meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你把第一个智能体接入聊天频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你刚部署好智能体服务，需要把它连上聊天频道
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and trigger a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up the agent service and need to connect it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude会一步步带你完成首个NanoClaw代理的接入：确认你的频道身份、选择或创建代理，并通过正常消息路径往你私信发欢迎消息，验证全链路可用。
howto.when: 当你要求接入第一个NanoClaw代理到私信频道，且频道凭证已配置、服务正在运行时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个NanoClaw代理，发到我的Discord私信
say.note: 引导完成身份确认和代理创建。

say.text: 我要在Telegram上设置NanoClaw的首个代理
say.note: 按步骤收集你的ID和名字。

say.text: 请把NanoClaw的第一个代理接到Slack私信
say.note: 会创建代理并发送欢迎DM。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude walks you through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel: resolves your channel identity, selects/creates the agent, and triggers a welcome DM through the normal delivery path to verify end-to-end.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel, after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

say_en.text: Set up the first NanoClaw agent and DM me on Discord
say_en.note: Guides identity resolution and agent creation.

say_en.text: I want to create the first NanoClaw agent on Telegram
say_en.note: Collects your ID and name step by step.

say_en.text: Wire up the first NanoClaw agent to Slack DMs
say_en.note: Creates the agent and sends a welcome DM.
